bdsg.muc_dich: Thu nghiem: nhieu tham so nhung moi token chi di qua mot chuyen gia. Chua phai ban phat hanh.

tham_so_uoc_tinh.cach_tinh: Xem huan-luyen/cau-hinh/tinh_tham_so.py. So kich hoat tinh y het ham get_model_params trong trainer/trainer_utils.py dong 20-30 cua MiniMind: base = tong - (tham_so_mot_chuyen_gia_tren_moi_lop * num_experts); kich_hoat = base + (tham_so_mot_chuyen_gia_tren_moi_lop * num_experts_per_tok).

vi_sao_chon_so_nay: 4 chuyen gia / top-1: dung y het minimind-3-moe. Day la cau hinh duy nhat ma MiniMind noi ro ho da do toc do (README_en.md: cham hon ban dense cung co khoang 50%).
moe_intermediate_size = intermediate_size = 2432: moi chuyen gia to bang mot FFN dac, khong thu nho. Day cung la mac dinh cua MiniMindConfig.
canh_bao: MiniMind tu viet trong README_en.md rang MOE cua ho la PyTorch thuan, khong co kernel hop nhat, nen LUC HUAN LUYEN cham hon dense cung co. Dung ky vong 'MoE thi nhanh hon'. Cai nhanh hon la luc suy luan, va chi khi da co kernel tot.
Trong so MoE nang 405 MB o fp16, gap 5.4 lan ban nho. Neu muc tieu la nguoi dung tai ve may ca nhan thi cau hinh nay KHONG phai lua chon mac dinh.
Xem canh bao vocab_size o nho.json, ap dung y het.
